body.purpose: Native message and button copy; prioritize scanability over branding theater.

label.purpose: Short context labels in authored BoudyOS media.

assetProvenance.origin: Existing BoudyOS canonical brand asset in the repository.
Generated locally by scripts/build_boudyos_inline_banner.py from the canonical BoudyOS avatar and deterministic palette/layout code.

narrative.overview: BoudyOS is operated inside Telegram. Its UI uses native messages and inline keyboards as a calm command surface: context first, grouped actions second, progressive disclosure for detail, and a reversible path at every step.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy with electric blue and cyan signals

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue and cyan indicate brand or action. Do not scatter bright color across inactive labels or decorative copy.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Every button names its action in words. Emoji may be user-configured for plugin lists, but never carries the only meaning of a control.

dos: Do use BoudyOS in user-facing help and dashboard copy.
Do keep every operational screen reversible.
Do default to immutable bundled media.
donts: Don't reintroduce upstream branding into user-facing surfaces.
Don't use random external images as the default.
Don't ship visible On/Off controls that share a toggle callback.
